sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:18143
Court No. - 77
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 39576 of 2024
Applicant :- Dhruva Kumar Singh Rathor And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Gaurang Saxena,Rudra Pratap Pandey,Vidhu Bhushan Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Rudra Pratap Pandey, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Sandeep Chaudhary,
learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking quashing of the summoning order date 30.5.2023 passed in complaint case No. 1311 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 452, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Gautam Budh Nagar.
3. At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicants submits that he does not want to press this application and wants to withdraw the same.
4. Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.

Order Date :- 7.2.2025 Vandana  Dhruva Kumar Singh Rathor And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120551595/
